metadata.description: Curated Claude Code plugins for AI agent development, workflows, product management, full-stack development, and analysis

plugins.name: agentic-engineering
plugins.description: Architecture standards and guardrails for production agentic AI on LangGraph, Pydantic AI, CrewAI and Langfuse: framework roles, state, model tiers, validation, human-in-the-loop, persistence, security, dependencies, testing and evals. Includes /agentic-engineering skill and agentic-engineer agent.

plugins.name: prompt-engineering
plugins.description: Design, optimize, and manage LLM prompts with focus on reliability, efficiency, and measurable outcomes. Includes /prompt-engineering skill and prompt-engineer agent.

plugins.name: agent-team
plugins.description: Orchestrate parallel coding agents — Agent Teams, worktree-isolated agents or parallel sessions — with mechanism choice, parallel-safety classification, contract-first interfaces and quality gates. Picks up prd2issues issue cuts. Adds a /agent-team skill.

plugins.name: brainstorming
plugins.description: Design-first exploration of intent, requirements and design for work too big to describe in one sentence; hands off to plan mode, braindump2prd/prd2issues or agent-team. Adds the /design-first skill.

plugins.name: engineering-standards
plugins.description: Small reviewable pull requests, review, merge and release discipline, rules for several agents on one repo, CLAUDE.md structure and where documentation and plans live, and how agents work in a sandbox (code in the sandbox, Docker stack on the host), with a swappable organisation profile. Includes /engineering-standards, /branch and /sbx (Claude in a Docker Sandbox on a new worktree, optionally with the full stack inside for self-run tests) skills.

plugins.name: braindump2prd
plugins.description: Interviews a PM thoroughly and turns a vague feature idea into a plain-language PRD and spec via a reviewed interview record (braindump_final); hands them over to the issue tracker (e.g. Linear). Adds a /braindump2prd skill.

plugins.name: prd2issues
plugins.description: Cuts a Ready PRD into milestones and a small set of readable, codebase-grounded issues in the tracker (e.g. Linear), one vertical slice and one reviewable pull request each. Adds a /prd2issues skill.

plugins.name: electron-dev
plugins.description: Standards and guardrails for secure, fast cross-platform desktop apps with Electron: Forge + Vite + TypeScript, sandboxed renderers, typed IPC, utilityProcess, fuses and ASAR integrity, code signing and notarization, auto-updates, app lifecycle, local data, store distribution, accessibility and localisation, Playwright/Vitest tests. Includes /electron-development skill and electron-developer agent.

plugins.name: fullstack-engineering
plugins.description: Guideline and reference implementation for web apps: Django system of record, optional FastAPI realtime service, Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, company SSO over OpenID Connect and/or external accounts with MFA, Docker, Task, SOPS, platform-neutral CI, staging and production from the same images. Includes /fullstack-engineering, /fullstack-scaffold and the fullstack-engineer agent.

plugins.name: equity-research
plugins.description: Institutional-grade equity research with chance/risk reports, DCF valuation, and investment recommendations for US-listed stocks. Adds a /equity-research skill.

plugins.name: uiux
plugins.description: UI/UX from user journey to verified screen: journey specs (job stories, breadboards, Gherkin acceptance), tool-agnostic design system architecture (DTCG tokens, components, accessibility), design in Penpot or Figma via MCP, screenshot-to-design-system, Pencil .pen files, and design-vs-implementation parity checks. Adds the uiux-journey-spec, uiux-design-system, uiux-design-penpot, uiux-design-figma, uiux-image2design, pencil-pen-generator and design-parity skills.

plugins.name: uiux-design-tailwindv4
plugins.description: Production-ready Tailwind CSS v4 design systems with CSS-first configuration, semantic tokens, OKLCH colors, component patterns (CVA), responsive layouts, dark mode, and accessibility. Includes optional shadcn/ui depth for rapid component development. Adds a /uiux-design-tailwindv4 skill.

plugins.name: uiux-design-vue3
plugins.description: Vue 3 development skills prioritizing Composition API with <script setup> for all greenfield work. Covers best practices, routing (Vue Router 4), Pinia state management, testing (Vitest/Playwright), debugging, JSX, Options API (brownfield only), and adaptable composables.

plugins.name: investment-memo
plugins.description: Senior VC Investment Analyst (Seed/Series A) producing institutional-grade investment memos from pitch decks and DD materials. Scores 30+ criteria across Team, Technology/IP, Market, Competition, Business Model, Financials with red-flag gates, BCSA adoption framework, and Deep-Tech Matrix positioning. Adds a /investment-memo skill.

plugins.name: prfaq-vision-builder
plugins.description: Guided Amazon Working Backwards PR/FAQ: one future-state vision document (press release plus lean FAQ) for internal tools or external products. Adds a /prfaq-vision-builder skill.

plugins.name: product-roadmap-3-layers
plugins.description: 3-layer product roadmap (Business Outcomes, Product & Features, Tech Enabler) in Now/Next/Later as one markdown document, from an interview or from a Notion roadmap database. Adds a /product-roadmap-3-layers skill.
